year_display.zh: 公元前 1 世纪后期编订

note.en: the classical Chinese text, several editions

review.en: Liu Xiang sorted six damaged manuscripts of persuaders' speeches and stratagems into thirty-three books arranged by state. What survives is less a chronicle than a book of argument: advisers selling alliances, fables invented on the spot, the logic of interest laid bare. As a record of events it is often unreliable; as a portrait of how the age reasoned it is unmatched, and its prose has been imitated ever since.
review.zh: 刘向把六种残乱的纵横家写本整理成三十三卷，按国分编。它与其说是编年记事，不如说是一部论辩之书：谋士兜售合纵连横，寓言随口编来，利害之理赤裸可见。作为史实常不可靠，作为那个时代如何思考的写照却无可替代，文章也被后世反复模仿。
